1.speaker: Magistrate Voss
1.text: The magistrate will talk about the ash road once the ledger balances, and the ledger needs six bolts' worth of cloth.

2.speaker: Magistrate Voss
2.text: Gather 6 Torn Cloth. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Magistrate Voss
1.text: Voss admits the warrens under the ash road are not a vermin problem. He wants to know what they actually are.

2.speaker: Magistrate Voss
2.text: Reach Entered Emberling Warrens. Come back to me when it is done.

barks.text: Order is not cruelty. Order is what keeps the chaos at the gate.
You will find, in time, that the law is a convenience of the ones who write it.
Careful. You speak to the only peace Sunreach has known.
